prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a lush backyard garden scene unfolds with intricate detail. On the left foreground, a woman in a yellow sundress kneels beside a terracotta pot, carefully planting purple petunias into dark soil. Next to her, a small brown dog sniffs at a green watering can lying on its side. In the center, a wooden picnic table holds a wicker basket filled with red apples and a glass pitcher of lemonade. A man in a blue plaid shirt stands behind the table, pouring the golden liquid into a clear glass held by a young girl sitting on a bench. To the right, a large oak tree provides shade, its branches hanging low over a hammock where a cat sleeps peacefully. A white ceramic bird bath sits near the tree trunk, reflecting the bright sunlight. In the background, a tall wooden fence is covered in climbing ivy and pink roses. The lighting is warm and natural, suggesting late afternoon sun casting long shadows across the green lawn. The composition balances the human activity in the center with the tranquil nature elements on the periphery, creating a harmonious and inviting atmosphere typical of a serene suburban retreat.
